attack_plan.narrative: Recent developments in Moscow have raised concerns about the whereabouts of Russian President Vladimir Putin. Unverified reports suggest that Putin has not been seen in public since March 13th, leading to speculation about his health or involvement in internal political machinations. The Kremlin has released a new photo of Putin and US President Obama, showing both leaders appearing fine, but the unusual circumstances surrounding Putin’s absence continue to fuel doubts. Strange occurrences reported from the Kremlin include the absence of certain decorations typically seen during important events, and white smoke being seen above the building. High-ranking officials and security personnel are reportedly holding emergency meetings in an undisclosed location to discuss the current situation, although the exact nature and timing of these meetings remain unclear. The State Department has expressed concern about a potential coup against Putin, indicating that the situation remains fluid and uncertain. The absence of Putin from public view, coupled with unverified reports suggesting his absence could be related to internal power struggles, leaves many questioning the true nature of the current political landscape in Russia. In a recent tweet, an anonymous source claimed that Putin was 'riding a weasel on the back of a woodpecker and he fell off and died,' though this has not been confirmed. Meanwhile, a Kremlin official has stated that Putin is back from 'me time' and is doing well, though the context of this statement is unclear. The situation in the Kremlin remains tense, with strange occurrences reported, such as white smoke being seen above the building and the absence of certain decorations typically seen during important events. The Kremlin has also released a new photo, which shows Putin and Kim Jong-un in what appears to be a less than flattering light, hinting at potential internal tensions. The situation continues to evolve, and the world watches closely to see how it will unfold.
